attempts.exactPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Create one premium realistic painterly raster character concept for the manifest-bound target "affinity-workflow-v1-death-knight-metal-v2".

Subject and threat:
- Species: death-knight.
- Threat presentation tier: elite; reference Grade 4; canonical Grade 4.
- Battlefield duty: formation-commander.
- Construction mode: armored-undead.

Identity invariants:
- undead armored commander identity
- skull or death mask
- small command pennant
- deliberate sword guard
- command seal beneath the gorget
- disciplined military posture
- the ribcage, spine, limb bones, and joints are themselves forged metal construction rather than a body hidden by ordinary plate armor

Anatomy invariants:
- humanoid biped
- believable armor load paths
- two arms and two legs
- articulated metallic marrow visibly carries load through the torso, arms, and legs

Affinity: metal.
Affinity expression: Forged anatomy replaces the ordinary hidden body: articulated load-bearing plates interlock with visible metallic marrow across ribcage, spine, limbs, and joints, while controlled fragments orbit a distinct magnetic core.
Counterplay cue: Articulated joints or the controlling magnetic core remain materially distinct.
Altered dimensions: material; anatomy; equipment; exposed-counterplay.
Permitted transformations: material; articulation; equipment; exposed weak point.
Prohibited traits: random giant horns; implausibly oversized sword; full-body colored glow; ordinary armor presented as an affinity without transformed construction; ordinary armored knight silhouette with an unchanged body concealed beneath conventional plate; construction materially indistinguishable from the Normal Death Knight reference.

Presentation:
- Style: Pack 2 premium realistic painterly medieval dark fantasy with coherent materials, controlled linework, grounded anatomy, and restrained local magical emission.
- Medium: premium realistic painterly raster character concept.
- Background: neutral cracked-stone floor against a charcoal-to-midnight backdrop.
- Lighting: controlled neutral key with restrained local affinity emission and readable materials.
- Composition: Exactly one full-body Death Knight in a disciplined three-quarter command stance; sword, boots, pennant finial, cape ends, and every controlled fragment remain centered inside the inner eighty-four percent of the finished canvas.
- Canvas: 1536 x 1024 image/png with at least 8 percent safe margin around the entire silhouette and all extremities.
- Framing lock: fit every hard extent—including weapon tip, standard, horns, tail, and effect wake—inside the central 84 percent of both canvas dimensions; leave a clearly empty border on all four sides.

Reference routing, in supplied order:
1. assets/enemies/experiments/affinity-workflow-v1/candidates/death-knight/normal-v1.png — Normal Death Knight candidate is a negative contrast reference only: the corrected Metal construction must remain recognizably related while differing through structural forged anatomy, articulation, and metallic marrow.
2. assets/enemies/review/pack-2/undead-v1.png — Fourth subject only: Death Knight identity, command silhouette, armor load paths, and restrained necromancy; do not transfer the sentinel, wraith, or bone mage.

Constraints:
- No labels, text, UI, frame, logo, or watermark.
- No extra creature, cropped extremity, blank band, unfinished region, or abrupt canvas cutoff.
- No resemblance to a published character or reference person.

findings.observation: The generation invocation completed but exposed no bindable image payload, preview, or source identifier, so no source-bound persistence or inspection was possible.

attempts.retryReason: The provider boundary exposed no bindable source receipt or inspectable canvas; the single permitted retry was used as a complete regeneration with the unchanged canonical prompt and ordered manifest references.
